messages.subject: Project Quartz — draft Disclosure Letter
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Attached is the draft Disclosure Letter for review. The principal specific disclosures are: the Wexbourne change-of-control clause (no consent yet); the warehouse grievance (exposure < £15k); the EU trade mark application pending; the lease break and rent review; and the December stock provisioning adjustment of £72k. The data room index is annexed. Grateful for comments.

Deepa Kovac
Birchall Stone LLP
